books.title: Essential Grammar in Use
books.description: Raymond Murphy'ning qizil kitobi (4-nashr) tartibida: 115 unit va 7 ilova, A1–B1. Tushuntirishlar o'zbekcha, mashqlar o'rniga — yangi misol gaplar.

sections.title: Present
sections.description: Hozirgi zamon: am/is/are, Present Continuous va Present Simple, ularning farqi, have va have got.

topics.title: am/is/are
topics.summary: be fe'lining hozirgi shakllari: I am, he/she/it is, we/you/they are; qisqa shakllar (I'm, it's) va inkor (isn't, aren't).

topics.title: am/is/are (questions)
topics.summary: am/is/are bilan savol: Are you ...? Is it ...?, so'roq so'zlari (where, what, how) va qisqa javoblar (Yes, I am).

topics.title: I am doing (present continuous)
topics.summary: Present Continuous: am/is/are + -ing — ayni paytda bo'layotgan harakat; -ing qo'shishning imlo qoidalari.

topics.title: are you doing? (present continuous questions)
topics.summary: Present Continuous savollari: Are you working? What is she doing? va qisqa javoblar.

topics.title: I do/work/like etc. (present simple)
topics.summary: Present Simple: doimiy, takroriy harakatlar va faktlar; he/she/it bilan `-s` / `-es` qo'shimchasi.

topics.title: I don't … (present simple negative)
topics.summary: Present Simple inkori: don't / doesn't + fe'l; doesn't dan keyin `-s` qo'shilmaydi.

topics.title: Do you … ? (present simple questions)
topics.summary: Present Simple savollari: Do you ...? Does she ...?, so'roq so'zlari bilan va qisqa javoblar.

topics.title: I am doing (present continuous) and I do (present simple)
topics.summary: Hozir bo'layotgan va odatiy harakat farqi; Continuous da ishlatilmaydigan fe'llar (know, like, want).

topics.title: I have … and I've got …
topics.summary: have va have got — egalik, oila, kasallik; inkor va savol shakllari, have breakfast kabi iboralarda faqat have.

sections.title: Past
sections.description: O'tgan zamon: was/were, Past Simple (to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar), Past Continuous va ularning farqi.

topics.title: was/were
topics.summary: be fe'lining o'tgan zamoni: was / were, inkor (wasn't, weren't) va savollar.

topics.title: worked/got/went etc. (past simple)
topics.summary: Past Simple: to'g'ri fe'llar (`-ed`) va noto'g'ri fe'llar (went, saw, bought); yesterday, last week, ago.

topics.title: I didn't … Did you … ? (past simple negative and questions)
topics.summary: Past Simple inkori va savoli: didn't / Did + fe'lning asosiy shakli; qisqa javoblar.

topics.title: I was doing (past continuous)
topics.summary: Past Continuous: was/were + -ing — o'tmishning ma'lum paytida davom etayotgan harakat.

topics.title: I was doing (past continuous) and I did (past simple)
topics.summary: Davom etayotgan harakat va uni bo'lgan voqea: I was walking when it started to rain; when va while.

sections.title: Present perfect
sections.description: Present Perfect: just, already, yet, ever, how long, for/since/ago va Past Simple bilan farqi.

topics.title: I have done (present perfect 1)
topics.summary: Present Perfect: have/has + V3 — o'tmishdagi harakatning hozirgi natijasi; V3 (past participle) shakllari.

topics.title: I've just … I've already … I haven't … yet (present perfect 2)
topics.summary: just, already va yet: hozirgina, allaqachon, hali ... emas — ma'nosi va gapdagi o'rni.

topics.title: Have you ever … ? (present perfect 3)
topics.summary: Hayot tajribasi: Have you ever ...?, never, before; gone va been farqi.

topics.title: How long have you … ? (present perfect 4)
topics.summary: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat: How long have you ...?, have been + -ing va for / since.

topics.title: for since ago
topics.summary: for (davomiylik), since (boshlanish nuqtasi) va ago (... oldin) — farqi va qaysi zamon bilan ishlatilishi.

topics.title: I have done (present perfect) and I did (past)
topics.summary: Present Perfect va Past Simple farqi: aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, in 2019) va hozirgi natija.

sections.title: Passive
sections.description: Majhul nisbat: is done, was done, is being done, has been done.

topics.title: is done was done (passive 1)
topics.summary: Majhul nisbat: is/are + V3 va was/were + V3; harakatni bajaruvchi — by bilan.

topics.title: is being done has been done (passive 2)
topics.summary: Majhul nisbatning davomli va perfekt shakllari: is being done, has been done; faol nisbat bilan taqqoslash.

sections.title: Verb forms
sections.description: be, have, do — yordamchi fe'l sifatida; to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llarning shakllari.

topics.title: be/have/do in present and past tenses
topics.summary: be, have, do yordamchi fe'l sifatida: qaysi zamonda qaysi biri, inkor va savollarda.

topics.title: Regular and irregular verbs
topics.summary: To'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar: uch shakli (V1, V2, V3), `-ed` imlosi, eng ko'p uchraydigan noto'g'ri fe'llar.

sections.title: Future
sections.description: Kelasi zamon: rejalar uchun Present Continuous, going to, will va shall.

topics.title: What are you doing tomorrow?
topics.summary: Kelishilgan rejalar uchun Present Continuous; jadval bo'yicha voqealar uchun Present Simple.

topics.title: I'm going to …
topics.summary: going to — oldindan qilingan qaror va niyat; ko'rinib turgan belgilarga qarab bashorat (It's going to rain).

topics.title: will/shall 1
topics.summary: will — kelajak haqida fakt va taxmin (I think ... will), will va won't shakllari.

topics.title: will/shall 2
topics.summary: will — gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror, taklif va va'da; Shall I ...? Shall we ...?

sections.title: Modals, imperative etc.
sections.description: Modal fe'llar: might, can/could, must, should, have to; would like, buyruq gaplar va used to.

topics.title: might
topics.summary: might — ehtimol, balki: I might go ...; might not, may bilan farqi.

topics.title: can and could
topics.summary: can / could — qobiliyat, imkoniyat va iltimos: can't, could (o'tmishda), Can you ...? Could you ...?

topics.title: must mustn't don't need to
topics.summary: must — zarurlik, mustn't — taqiq, don't need to — kerak emas; uchalasining farqi.

topics.title: should
topics.summary: should — maslahat va to'g'ri ish: You should ..., I think / I don't think ... should.

topics.title: I have to …
topics.summary: have to — qoida yoki sharoit tufayli majburiyat: has to, had to, don't have to; must bilan farqi.

topics.title: Would you like … ? I'd like …
topics.summary: Xushmuomala taklif va istak: Would you like ...?, I'd like ...; Do you like ...? bilan farqi.

topics.title: Do this! Don't do that! Let's do this!
topics.summary: Buyruq gap: Come here!, inkor buyruq Don't ...!, birgalikka taklif Let's ... va Let's not ...

topics.title: I used to …
topics.summary: used to — o'tmishdagi odat va holat (endi yo'q): didn't use to, Did you use to ...?

sections.title: There and it
sections.description: there is / there are barcha zamonlarda va it bilan boshlanadigan gaplar (vaqt, ob-havo, masofa).

topics.title: there is there are
topics.summary: there is / there are — biror joyda nimadir bor; inkor, savol va qisqa javoblar; there is va it is farqi.

topics.title: there was/were there has/have been there will be
topics.summary: there ... boshqa zamonlarda: there was/were, there has/have been, there will be.

topics.title: It …
topics.summary: It bilan gaplar: vaqt, kun, ob-havo, masofa; It's ... to ...; it va there farqi.

sections.title: Auxiliary verbs
sections.description: Yordamchi fe'llar: qisqa javoblar, qayta so'roq (Are you?), so am I / neither do I, inkor shakllar.

topics.title: I am, I don't etc.
topics.summary: Fe'lni takrorlamasdan qisqa javob: Yes, I am. / No, I don't.; I'm not, but my sister is.

topics.title: Have you? Are you? Don't you? etc.
topics.summary: Qiziqish bildiruvchi qayta so'roq (Are you? Do you?) va tasdiq so'roqlari (It's nice, isn't it?).

topics.title: too/either so am I / neither do I etc.
topics.summary: too va either; so am I / neither do I — boshqa kishining fikriga qo'shilish.

topics.title: isn't, haven't, don't etc. (negatives)
topics.summary: Barcha zamonlardagi inkor: isn't, haven't, don't, didn't, won't, can't — umumiy tizim.

sections.title: Questions
sections.description: Savol tuzish: so'roq so'zlari, who/what ega va to'ldiruvchi sifatida, predlog bilan tugaydigan savollar, bilvosita savollar.

topics.title: is it … ? have you … ? do they … ? etc. (questions 1)
topics.summary: Savolda so'z tartibi: yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin; Why isn't ...? kabi inkor savollar.

topics.title: Who saw you? Who did you see? (questions 2)
topics.summary: who / what — ega va to'ldiruvchi haqida savol: Who saw you? va Who did you see? farqi.

topics.title: Who is she talking to? What is it like? (questions 3)
topics.summary: Predlog bilan tugaydigan savollar (Who is she talking to?) va What is it like? — qanaqa?

topics.title: What … ? Which … ? How … ? (questions 4)
topics.summary: what va which farqi, How + sifat/ravish: how big, how often, how far, how much / how many.

topics.title: How long does it take … ?
topics.summary: Vaqt sarfi: How long does it take to ...?, It takes ... va It took me ... .

topics.title: Do you know where … ? I don't know what … etc.
topics.summary: Bilvosita savollar: Do you know where ...?, I don't know what ... — so'z tartibi va if / whether.

sections.title: Reported speech
sections.description: O'zlashtirma gap: She said that ..., He told me that ...

topics.title: She said that … He told me that …
topics.summary: O'zlashtirma gap: say va tell farqi, zamonning bir pog'ona orqaga surilishi (is → was, will → would).

sections.title: -ing and to …
sections.description: Fe'ldan keyin to ... yoki -ing, want somebody to ..., maqsad ma'nosidagi to.

topics.title: work/working go/going do/doing
topics.summary: Fe'l shakllari: asosiy shakl (can, will dan keyin), to + fe'l (want to), -ing (am doing) va V3.

topics.title: to … (I want to do) and -ing (I enjoy doing)
topics.summary: Qaysi fe'ldan keyin to ..., qaysi biridan keyin -ing: want to, decide to va enjoy, finish, mind + -ing.

topics.title: I want you to … I told you to …
topics.summary: want / ask / tell / advise somebody to ... va make / let somebody do.

topics.title: I went to the shop to …
topics.summary: Maqsad: to + fe'l (nima uchun?), for + ot va ularning farqi.

sections.title: Go, get, do, make and have
sections.description: Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llar: go, get, do va make farqi, have bilan iboralar.

topics.title: go to … go on … go for … go -ing
topics.summary: go bilan iboralar: go to work, go on holiday, go for a walk, go shopping, go swimming.

topics.title: get
topics.summary: get ning ma'nolari: olmoq, sotib olmoq, bo'lib qolmoq (get tired), yetib bormoq (get home), get up, get on.

topics.title: do and make
topics.summary: do va make farqi: do homework, do the shopping va make a cake, make a mistake, make a phone call.

topics.title: have
topics.summary: have bilan iboralar: have breakfast, have a shower, have a good time, have a look; Continuous da ishlatilishi.

sections.title: Pronouns and possessives
sections.description: Olmoshlar: I/me, my/mine, whose, myself va egalik qo'shimchasi -'s.

topics.title: I/me he/him they/them etc.
topics.summary: Kishilik olmoshlari: ega shakli (I, he, they) va to'ldiruvchi shakli (me, him, them).

topics.title: my/his/their etc.
topics.summary: Egalik olmoshlari: my, your, his, her, its, our, their; its va it's farqi.

topics.title: Whose is this? It's mine/yours/hers etc.
topics.summary: Mustaqil egalik olmoshlari: mine, yours, hers ...; Whose ...? savoli va a friend of mine.

topics.title: I/me/my/mine
topics.summary: Olmoshlarning to'rt shakli birga: I / me / my / mine — qaysi biri qayerda; umumiy jadval.

topics.title: myself/yourself/themselves etc.
topics.summary: O'zlik olmoshlari: myself, yourself ...; by myself (o'zim, yolg'iz) va each other farqi.

topics.title: -'s (Kate's camera / my brother's car etc.)
topics.summary: Egalik qo'shimchasi `-'s` va `-s'`: Kate's camera, my parents' house; of bilan farqi.

sections.title: A and the
sections.description: Artikllar: a/an, birlik va ko'plik, sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar, the qachon kerak va qachon kerak emas.

topics.title: a/an …
topics.summary: Noaniq artikl a / an: tovushga qarab tanlash (a university, an hour), kasb va narsa nomlari oldida.

topics.title: train(s) bus(es) (singular and plural)
topics.summary: Otlarning ko'pligi: `-s` / `-es` / `-ies`, noto'g'ri ko'plik (children, men), doim ko'plikdagi otlar (jeans, people).

topics.title: a bottle / some water (countable/uncountable 1)
topics.summary: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar: a bottle, some water; a piece of ..., a glass of ...

topics.title: a cake / some cake / some cakes (countable/uncountable 2)
topics.summary: a / some bilan: a cake, some cake, some cakes; advice, information, news kabi sanalmaydigan otlar.

topics.title: a/an and the
topics.summary: a/an va the farqi: birinchi marta tilga olingan va ma'lum narsa; yagona narsalar.

topics.title: the …
topics.summary: the ishlatiladigan holatlar: the same, the sun, the radio, the top / the end; play the piano.

topics.title: go to work go home go to the cinema
topics.summary: Artiklsiz iboralar: go to work, at school, in bed, go home va the bilan: go to the cinema, the bank.

topics.title: I like music I hate exams
topics.summary: Umumiy ma'nodagi otlar artiklsiz (I like music, Dogs are ...) va aniq narsa uchun the.

topics.title: the … (names of places)
topics.summary: Joy nomlari: the bilan (the USA, the Thames, the Alps) va the siz (Uzbekistan, Lake Victoria).

sections.title: Determiners and pronouns
sections.description: this/that, one/ones, some/any, no/none, somebody/nothing, every/all, both/either/neither, much/many, few/little.

topics.title: this/that/these/those
topics.summary: Ko'rsatish olmoshlari: yaqin va uzoqdagi narsa, birlik va ko'plik; telefonda va tanishtirishda this.

topics.title: one/ones
topics.summary: one / ones — otni takrorlamaslik uchun: this one, the blue ones, Which one?

topics.title: some and any
topics.summary: some (darak gapda, taklif va iltimosda) va any (inkor va savolda).

topics.title: not + any no none
topics.summary: not any, no va none: There isn't any ... / There is no ... / None.

topics.title: not + anybody/anyone/anything nobody/no-one/nothing
topics.summary: not anybody / nobody, not anything / nothing — ingliz gapida bitta inkor qoidasi.

topics.title: somebody/anything/nowhere etc.
topics.summary: some-, any-, no- birikmalari: somebody, anything, nowhere, somewhere; something to eat.

topics.title: every and all
topics.summary: every + birlikdagi ot, all + ko'plik; everybody, everything, everywhere; all day va every day.

topics.title: all most some any no/none
topics.summary: Miqdor so'zlari: all, most, some, any, no; ... of + ot (most of the people).

topics.title: both either neither
topics.summary: Ikki narsa haqida: both (ikkalasi ham), either (biri), neither (hech biri); both ... and, either ... or.

topics.title: a lot much many
topics.summary: a lot of, much (sanalmaydigan), many (sanaladigan) — darak, inkor va savol gaplarda.

topics.title: (a) little (a) few
topics.summary: (a) little + sanalmaydigan, (a) few + sanaladigan; a little va little farqi (biroz va juda kam).

sections.title: Adjectives and adverbs
sections.description: Sifat va ravish, qiyosiy va orttirma daraja (older, the oldest), as ... as, enough va too.

topics.title: old/nice/interesting etc. (adjectives)
topics.summary: Sifatlar: otdan oldin va be, look, feel, smell kabi fe'llardan keyin; sifat shakli o'zgarmaydi.

topics.title: quickly/badly/suddenly etc. (adverbs)
topics.summary: Ravishlar: sifat + `-ly` (quick → quickly), good → well, hard, fast; sifat va ravish farqi.

topics.title: old/older expensive / more expensive
topics.summary: Qiyosiy daraja: `-er` (older) va more (more expensive), noto'g'ri shakllar (better, worse, further).

topics.title: older than … more expensive than …
topics.summary: than bilan taqqoslash: older than me; much / a bit / far bilan kuchaytirish.

topics.title: not as … as
topics.summary: as ... as (... dek), not as ... as (... chalik emas); the same as.

topics.title: the oldest the most expensive
topics.summary: Orttirma daraja: the oldest, the most expensive, the best; the best ... I've ever ...

topics.title: enough
topics.summary: enough: sifat/ravishdan keyin (old enough) va otdan oldin (enough money); enough for ... / to ...

topics.title: too
topics.summary: too + sifat (haddan tashqari): too hot, too much / too many; too ... for ... / to ...; too va very farqi.

sections.title: Word order
sections.description: Gapda so'z tartibi: fe'l va to'ldiruvchi, always/often ning o'rni, still/yet/already, give me / give it to me.

topics.title: He speaks English very well. (word order 1)
topics.summary: Fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga hech narsa qo'yilmaydi; joy va vaqt ifodalarining tartibi.

topics.title: always/usually/often etc. (word order 2)
topics.summary: always, usually, often, sometimes, never kabi so'zlarning o'rni: fe'ldan oldin, be dan keyin.

topics.title: still yet already
topics.summary: still (hali ham), yet (hali; savol va inkorda), already (allaqachon) — ma'nosi va o'rni.

topics.title: Give me that book! Give it to me!
topics.summary: Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'llar: give me the book / give it to me; give, lend, send, show, buy.

sections.title: Conjunctions and clauses
sections.description: Bog'lovchilar va ergash gaplar: and/but/so/because, when, if (real va noreal shart), who/which/that.

topics.title: and but or so because
topics.summary: Bog'lovchilar: and, but, or, so (shuning uchun), because (chunki) — gaplarni bog'lash.

topics.title: When …
topics.summary: When bilan ergash gap: kelasi zamon ma'nosida ham Present Simple (when I get home); before, after, while, until.

topics.title: If we go … If you see … etc.
topics.summary: Real shart: If + Present Simple, ... will ...; if va when farqi.

topics.title: If I had … If we went … etc.
topics.summary: Noreal shart: If + Past Simple, ... would ...; If I were you ...

topics.title: a person who … a thing that/which … (relative clauses 1)
topics.summary: Aniqlovchi ergash gap: who (odam), which / that (narsa) — ega vazifasida.

topics.title: the people we met the hotel you stayed at (relative clauses 2)
topics.summary: who/that/which tushib qoladigan holatlar: the people we met; predlog oxirida — the hotel you stayed at.

sections.title: Prepositions
sections.description: Predloglar: vaqt (at/on/in, for/since, during), joy (in/at/on, under, through), sifat va fe'l bilan keladigan predloglar.

topics.title: at 8 o'clock on Monday in April
topics.summary: Vaqt predloglari: at (soat, at night), on (kun, sana), in (oy, yil, fasl, in the morning).

topics.title: from … to until since for
topics.summary: from ... to, until / till, since va for — vaqt oralig'i va davomiylik.

topics.title: before after during while
topics.summary: before, after, during + ot, while + gap; before / after + -ing.

topics.title: in at on (places 1)
topics.summary: Joy predloglari: in (ichida), at (nuqtada), on (ustida) — asosiy ma'nolari.

topics.title: in at on (places 2)
topics.summary: Turg'un iboralar: in bed, at home, at work, on the train, in a car, on the second floor.

topics.title: to in at (places 3)
topics.summary: Harakat (go to, come to) va joyda bo'lish (be in / at); arrive in / at, get to, go home.

topics.title: under, behind, opposite etc.
topics.summary: Joy predloglari: next to, between, in front of, behind, opposite, under, above, below.

topics.title: up, over, through etc.
topics.summary: Harakat yo'nalishi: up, down, into, out of, over, under, through, along, across, round.

topics.title: on at by with about
topics.summary: on holiday, at 60 km an hour, by car, by Shakespeare, with / without, a book about ...

topics.title: afraid of … , good at … etc. of/at/for etc. (prepositions) + -ing
topics.summary: Sifat + predlog: afraid of, good at, interested in, angry with; predlogdan keyin -ing.

topics.title: listen to … , look at … etc. (verb + preposition)
topics.summary: Fe'l + predlog: listen to, look at, wait for, talk to, depend on; savollarda predlog oxirida.

sections.title: Phrasal verbs
sections.description: Frazali fe'llar: go in, fall off, put on, take off — ma'nosi va to'ldiruvchining o'rni.

topics.title: go in, fall off, run away etc. (phrasal verbs 1)
topics.summary: To'ldiruvchisiz frazali fe'llar: go in, get up, sit down, come back, look out, break down.

topics.title: put on your shoes put your shoes on (phrasal verbs 2)
topics.summary: To'ldiruvchili frazali fe'llar: put on / take off, turn on / off; olmosh doim o'rtada: put it on.

sections.title: Appendices
sections.description: Ilovalar: barcha zamonlarda majhul nisbat, noto'g'ri fe'llar, qisqa shakllar, imlo qoidalari va frazali fe'llar ro'yxati.

topics.title: Active and passive
topics.summary: Barcha zamonlarda faol va majhul nisbat yonma-yon: clean / is cleaned, has cleaned / has been cleaned ...

topics.title: List of irregular verbs
topics.summary: Noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati: V1 – V2 – V3, ma'nosi va misollar bilan.

topics.title: Irregular verbs in groups
topics.summary: Noto'g'ri fe'llar guruhlarda: shakli o'xshashlar birga (cut – cut – cut; sing – sang – sung) — eslab qolish oson.

topics.title: Short forms (he's / I'd / don't etc.)
topics.summary: Qisqa shakllar: I'm, he's, they've, I'd, won't, can't; 's — is yoki has, 'd — had yoki would.

topics.title: Spelling
topics.summary: Imlo qoidalari: `-s`/`-es`, `-ing`, `-ed`, `-er`/`-est`, `-ly` qo'shilganda harf o'zgarishi (stop → stopped, happy → happier).

topics.title: Phrasal verbs (take off / give up etc.)
topics.summary: Ko'p ishlatiladigan frazali fe'llar: take off, give up, carry on, find out, run out ... ma'nosi bilan.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs + object (put out a fire / give up your job etc.)
topics.summary: To'ldiruvchi oladigan frazali fe'llar: put out, give up, fill in, look up, turn down ... va olmoshning o'rni.

books.title: English Grammar in Use
books.description: Raymond Murphy'ning ko'k kitobi (5-nashr) tartibida: 145 unit va 7 ilova, B1–B2. Tushuntirishlar o'zbekcha, mashqlar o'rniga — yangi misol gaplar.

sections.title: Present and past
sections.description: Hozirgi va o'tgan zamonlar: Present Continuous va Present Simple farqi, holat fe'llari, Past Simple va Past Continuous.

topics.title: Present continuous (I am doing)
topics.summary: Present Continuous: hozir va shu kunlarda davom etayotgan, vaqtinchalik harakat; o'zgarib borayotgan holatlar (is getting, is rising).

topics.title: Present simple (I do)
topics.summary: Present Simple: umumiy faktlar, odatlar, qanchalik tez-tez; I promise, I suggest kabi aytish bilan bajariladigan harakatlar.

topics.title: Present continuous and present simple 1 (I am doing and I do)
topics.summary: Ikki zamon farqi: vaqtinchalik va doimiy holat, hozirgi harakat va odat; always + Continuous (shikoyat ma'nosida).

topics.title: Present continuous and present simple 2 (I am doing and I do)
topics.summary: Continuous da ishlatilmaydigan holat fe'llari (know, want, belong); see, think, have, be ning ikki ma'nosi.

topics.title: Past simple (I did)
topics.summary: Past Simple: tugagan o'tmish voqealari, to'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar, inkor va savollar.

topics.title: Past continuous (I was doing)
topics.summary: Past Continuous: o'tmishning aniq paytida davom etayotgan harakat; fon va uni bo'lgan voqea (when / while).

sections.title: Present perfect and past
sections.description: Present Perfect (oddiy va davomli), for/since, Past Simple bilan farqi, Past Perfect, have got va used to.

topics.title: Present perfect 1 (I have done)
topics.summary: Present Perfect: o'tmishdagi harakatning hozirgi natijasi va yangilik; just, already, yet; gone va been.

topics.title: Present perfect 2 (I have done)
topics.summary: Hayot tajribasi va tugamagan davr: ever, never, today, this week; It's the first time I've ...

topics.title: Present perfect continuous (I have been doing)
topics.summary: have been + -ing: hozirgina tugagan yoki hali davom etayotgan jarayon va uning izlari.

topics.title: Present perfect continuous and simple (I have been doing and I have done)
topics.summary: Jarayon (have been doing) va natija (have done): How long? va How much / How many? savollari.

topics.title: how long have you (been) … ?
topics.summary: How long ...? — boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat; am/is (hozir) va have been (qanchadan beri) farqi.

topics.title: for and since when … ? and how long … ?
topics.summary: for va since farqi; When did ...? va How long has ...?; It's two years since ...

topics.title: Present perfect and past 1 (I have done and I did)
topics.summary: Present Perfect yoki Past Simple: natija hozir ko'rinadimi yoki voqea tugaganmi; yangilik va uning tafsilotlari.

topics.title: Present perfect and past 2 (I have done and I did)
topics.summary: Tugagan vaqt (yesterday, in 2015) va tugamagan davr (today, this year, recently) bilan zamon tanlash.

topics.title: Past perfect (I had done)
topics.summary: Past Perfect: o'tmishdagi voqeadan ham oldin bo'lgan harakat; Past Simple bilan taqqoslash.

topics.title: Past perfect continuous (I had been doing)
topics.summary: had been + -ing: o'tmishdagi biror paytgacha davom etgan jarayon; Past Continuous bilan farqi.

topics.title: have and have got
topics.summary: have va have got (egalik, kasallik, aloqalar); have breakfast / a shower kabi harakat iboralari faqat have bilan.

topics.title: used to (do)
topics.summary: used to: o'tmishdagi odat va holat (endi yo'q); didn't use to, Did you use to ...?; Present Simple bilan farqi.

sections.title: Future
sections.description: Kelajak: rejalar uchun hozirgi zamonlar, going to, will/shall, Future Continuous va Future Perfect, when / if dan keyingi zamon.

topics.title: Present tenses (I am doing / I do) for the future
topics.summary: Kelishilgan reja — Present Continuous, jadval — Present Simple; going to bilan farqi.

topics.title: I'm going to (do)
topics.summary: going to: niyat va hozirgi belgilarga asoslangan bashorat; was / were going to — amalga oshmagan reja.

topics.title: will and shall 1
topics.summary: will: gapirayotgan paytdagi qaror, taklif, va'da, iltimos; won't — rad etish; Shall I / Shall we ...?

topics.title: will and shall 2
topics.summary: will — kelajak haqida taxmin: I think / probably / I'm sure + will; reja uchun will ishlatilmasligi.

topics.title: I will and I'm going to
topics.summary: will va going to farqi: qaror qachon qabul qilingan; bashoratda — fikr (will) va belgi (going to).

topics.title: will be doing and will have done
topics.summary: Future Continuous (ayni paytda davom etayotgan bo'ladi) va Future Perfect (... gacha tugagan bo'ladi).

topics.title: when I do and when I've done if and when
topics.summary: Vaqt va shart ergash gaplarida kelasi zamon o'rniga Present Simple / Present Perfect; if va when farqi.

sections.title: Modals
sections.description: Modal fe'llar: can/could/be able to, must/can't, may/might, have to, needn't, should, had better, would, iltimos va takliflar.

topics.title: can, could and (be) able to
topics.summary: Qobiliyat va imkoniyat: can, could, be able to (barcha zamonlarda); could va was able to farqi.

topics.title: could (do) and could have (done)
topics.summary: could — imkoniyat va taklif; could have done — o'tmishda imkon bo'lgan, lekin amalga oshmagan; couldn't have.

topics.title: must and can't
topics.summary: Mantiqiy xulosa: must (aniq shunday), can't (bo'lishi mumkin emas); must have done, can't have done.

topics.title: may and might 1
topics.summary: may / might — ehtimol: may be, might not; may have done / might have done — o'tmish haqida taxmin.

topics.title: may and might 2
topics.summary: might — kelajakdagi ehtimol va reja; might as well; may / might bilan taklif.

topics.title: have to and must
topics.summary: Majburiyat: must (so'zlovchining fikri) va have to (tashqi qoida); don't have to va mustn't farqi; have got to.

topics.title: must mustn't needn't
topics.summary: must (shart), mustn't (taqiq), needn't / don't need to (kerak emas); needn't have done.

topics.title: should 1
topics.summary: should — maslahat, fikr va kutilgan narsa: You should ..., I don't think you should ..., should have done.

topics.title: should 2
topics.summary: insist, suggest, recommend dan keyin should; It's important that ... should; If ... should; I should imagine.

topics.title: I'd better … it's time …
topics.summary: had better — aniq vaziyatdagi maslahat va ogohlantirish; It's time to ... / It's time somebody did ...

topics.title: would
topics.summary: would — tasavvur qilingan holat, would have done, o'tmishdagi odat va will ning o'tmishdagi shakli.

topics.title: can/could/would you … ? etc. (Requests, offers, permission and invitations)
topics.summary: Iltimos, taklif, ruxsat va taklifnoma: Can you ...? Could I ...? Would you mind ...? Would you like ...?

sections.title: if and wish
sections.description: Shart gaplar (real, hozirgi va o'tmishdagi xayoliy) va wish bilan istak va afsus.

topics.title: if I do … and if I did …
topics.summary: Real shart (if I do ... I'll) va xayoliy shart (if I did ... I'd): qachon qaysi biri tanlanadi.

topics.title: if I knew … I wish I knew …
topics.summary: Hozirgi xayoliy holat: if I knew, I wish I had ...; if I were; would va could bilan.

topics.title: if I had known … I wish I had known …
topics.summary: O'tmishdagi xayoliy holat: if I had known, I would have ...; I wish I had ... — afsus bildirish.

topics.title: wish
topics.summary: wish ning turlari: wish somebody luck, I wish I knew, I wish I had done, I wish you would ... (norozilik).

sections.title: Passive
sections.description: Majhul nisbat barcha shakllarda, It is said that ..., have something done.

topics.title: Passive 1 (is done / was done)
topics.summary: Majhul nisbat: qachon ishlatiladi, by bilan bajaruvchi, Present va Past Simple va boshqa zamonlarda.

topics.title: Passive 2 (be done / been done / being done)
topics.summary: Majhul infinitiv (can be done, to be done), perfekt (has been done) va -ing shakli (being done).

topics.title: Passive 3
topics.summary: Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'llar (I was offered ...), I was born, get + V3 (get married, get hurt).

topics.title: it is said that … he is said to … he is supposed to …
topics.summary: Mish-mish va umumiy fikr: It is said / believed that ..., He is said to ..., be supposed to.

topics.title: have something done
topics.summary: Ishni boshqaga qildirish: have / get something done (I had my car repaired); boshqaning harakatidan zarar ko'rish.

sections.title: Reported speech
sections.description: O'zlashtirma gap: zamon surilishi, say va tell, buyruq va iltimoslarni o'zlashtirish.

topics.title: Reported speech 1 (he said that …)
topics.summary: O'zlashtirma gap: say va tell, zamon surilishi (am → was, will → would) va so'zlarning o'zgarishi.

topics.title: Reported speech 2
topics.summary: Zamon surilmaydigan holatlar (hali ham rost bo'lsa), tell / ask somebody to ..., buyruq va iltimosni o'zlashtirish.

sections.title: Questions and auxiliary verbs
sections.description: Savol tuzish, bilvosita savollar, yordamchi fe'l bilan qisqa javoblar va tasdiq so'roqlari (question tags).

topics.title: Questions 1
topics.summary: Savol tuzish: so'z tartibi, ega haqida savol (Who phoned?), predlog oxirida, inkor savollar (Didn't you ...?).

topics.title: Questions 2 (do you know where … ? / he asked me where …)
topics.summary: Bilvosita va o'zlashtirma savollar: so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek; if / whether.

topics.title: Auxiliary verbs (have/do/can etc.) I think so / I hope so etc.
topics.summary: Yordamchi fe'l bilan qisqa javob va munosabat (So do I, Neither can I, Have you?); I think so / I hope not.

topics.title: Question tags (do you? isn't it? etc.)
topics.summary: Tasdiq so'roqlari: inkor gapdan keyin ijobiy tag va aksincha; Let's ..., shall we?; buyruqdan keyin will you?

sections.title: -ing and to …
sections.description: Fe'l + -ing yoki to ..., ma'nosi o'zgaradigan fe'llar, prefer / would rather, be used to, predlog + -ing, maqsad va -ing ergash gaplari.

topics.title: Verb + -ing (enjoy doing / stop doing etc.)
topics.summary: -ing oladigan fe'llar: enjoy, mind, suggest, avoid, consider, admit, deny; having done; not -ing.

topics.title: Verb + to … (decide to … / forget to … etc.)
topics.summary: to + fe'l oladigan fe'llar: decide, promise, refuse, manage, seem, pretend; to be doing / to have done.

topics.title: Verb (+ object) + to … (I want you to …)
topics.summary: want / ask / expect somebody to ...; tell, advise, remind, warn, persuade; make / let + to siz infinitiv.

topics.title: Verb + -ing or to … 1 (remember, regret etc.)
topics.summary: remember, regret, go on, stop: -ing va to ... bilan ma'no o'zgaradi; begin, start, continue — ikkalasi bir xil.

topics.title: Verb + -ing or to … 2 (try, need, help)
topics.summary: try to / try -ing, need to / need -ing (needs cleaning), help to va can't help -ing.

topics.title: Verb + -ing or to … 3 (like / would like etc.)
topics.summary: like, love, hate, prefer + -ing / to ...; would like / would love + to ...; would like to have done.

topics.title: prefer and would rather
topics.summary: prefer -ing / to ...; would prefer to ...; would rather do; would rather somebody did ...

topics.title: Preposition (in/for/about etc.) + -ing
topics.summary: Predlogdan keyin -ing: interested in, instead of, without, before / after, by -ing; look forward to -ing.

topics.title: be/get used to … (I'm used to …)
topics.summary: be used to -ing (o'rganib qolgan), get used to (ko'nikmoq); used to do bilan farqi.

topics.title: Verb + preposition + -ing (succeed in -ing / insist on -ing etc.)
topics.summary: succeed in, insist on, think of, dream of, approve of -ing; accuse / prevent / thank somebody for / from -ing.

topics.title: there's no point in -ing, it's worth -ing etc.
topics.summary: -ing bilan iboralar: there's no point in, it's (not) worth, have difficulty -ing, a waste of time, spend time -ing, go -ing.

topics.title: to … , for … and so that …
topics.summary: Maqsad: to ... va in order to, for + ot, so that ... can / will; to va for farqi.

topics.title: Adjective + to …
topics.summary: Sifat + to ...: easy / hard / nice to ...; It's nice of you to ...; sure / certain / the first to ...

topics.title: to … (afraid to do) and preposition + -ing (afraid of -ing)
topics.summary: afraid to / afraid of -ing, sorry to / sorry for, interested to / interested in — ma'no farqlari.

topics.title: see somebody do and see somebody doing
topics.summary: His fe'llari: see / hear / watch somebody do (to'liq harakat) va doing (jarayonning bir qismi).

topics.title: -ing clauses (He hurt his knee playing football.)
topics.summary: -ing ergash gaplari: bir vaqtdagi va ketma-ket harakatlar (having done), sabab (Being tired, ...).

sections.title: Articles and nouns
sections.description: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar, a/an va the ning barcha holatlari, nomlar, ko'plik, ot + ot va -'s / of.

topics.title: Countable and uncountable 1
topics.summary: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar: a / an, ko'plik, some; ikki ma'noli otlar (a hair / hair, a light / light).

topics.title: Countable and uncountable 2
topics.summary: Inglizchada sanalmaydigan, o'zbekchada sanaladigan otlar: advice, information, news, furniture, luggage, work, travel.

topics.title: Countable nouns with a/an and some
topics.summary: Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot oldida a / an shart; kasb, tavsif va ta'rifda; ko'plikda some va artiklsiz.

topics.title: a/an and the
topics.summary: a/an va the: birinchi va qayta tilga olish, umumiy va aniq; yagona narsalar oldida the.

topics.title: the 1
topics.summary: the: yagona narsa (the sun, the government), the same, the cinema, the sea, play the guitar.

topics.title: the 2 (school / the school etc.)
topics.summary: school, university, hospital, prison, church: artiklsiz (vazifasi ma'nosida) va the bilan (bino ma'nosida).

topics.title: the 3 (children / the children)
topics.summary: Umumiy ma'noda artiklsiz ko'plik va sanalmaydigan ot (Children love ...) va aniq guruh — the children.

topics.title: the 4 (the giraffe / the telephone / the old etc.)
topics.summary: the + birlik ot — tur yoki ixtiro haqida; the + sifat (the old, the rich); the + millat (the French).

topics.title: Names with and without the 1
topics.summary: Ismlar, unvonlar, mamlakatlar, shaharlar, ko'llar, tog'lar va orollar: the bilan va the siz.

topics.title: Names with and without the 2
topics.summary: Ko'chalar, binolar, mehmonxonalar, muzeylar, universitetlar, gazeta va tashkilotlar nomlari: the qachon kerak.

topics.title: Singular and plural
topics.summary: Doim ko'plikdagi otlar (trousers, scissors), -s bilan tugaydigan birlik otlar (news, maths), guruh otlari (the team), police.

topics.title: Noun + noun (a bus driver / a headache)
topics.summary: Ot + ot birikmalari: birinchi ot sifat vazifasida (a bus driver, a ten-pound note); a two-hour journey.

topics.title: -'s (your sister's name) and of … (the name of the book)
topics.summary: -'s va of farqi: odam va hayvonlar uchun -'s, narsalar uchun of; vaqt bilan -'s (today's news).

sections.title: Pronouns and determiners
sections.description: O'zlik olmoshlari, a friend of mine, there va it, some/any, no/none, much/many, all/most, both/either, every/each.

topics.title: myself/yourself/themselves etc.
topics.summary: O'zlik olmoshlari: ega va to'ldiruvchi bir kishi bo'lganda; each other bilan farqi; kuchaytirish ma'nosi.

topics.title: a friend of mine my own house on my own / by myself
topics.summary: a friend of mine, my own ..., on my own / by myself — mustaqil egalik va yolg'iz bajarish.

topics.title: there … and it …
topics.summary: there is / there will be / there must be va it: yangi narsani kiritish va ma'lum narsaga ishora.

topics.title: some and any
topics.summary: some va any: darak, inkor va savolda; taklif va iltimosda some; any — «qaysi biri bo'lsa ham».

topics.title: no/none/any nothing/nobody etc.
topics.summary: no + ot, none (of), nothing / nobody — inglizchada bitta inkor; any bilan birgalikda.

topics.title: much, many, little, few, a lot, plenty
topics.summary: Miqdor so'zlari: much / many, a lot of, plenty of; little va a little, few va a few — ma'no farqi.

topics.title: all / all of most / most of no / none of etc.
topics.summary: all, most, some, any, no + ot va ... of the / of my / of them; none of + fe'l.

topics.title: both / both of neither / neither of either / either of
topics.summary: Ikki narsa haqida: both (of), either (of), neither (of); both ... and, either ... or, neither ... nor.

topics.title: all every whole
topics.summary: all, every va whole: all day / every day / the whole day; everybody / everything; all va everything farqi.

topics.title: each and every
topics.summary: each (har biri alohida) va every (hammasi birga); each of, each one; gapdagi o'rni.

sections.title: Relative clauses
sections.description: Aniqlovchi ergash gaplar: who/that/which, ularsiz gaplar, whose/whom/where, qo'shimcha ma'lumot gaplari, -ing va -ed qisqartmalari.

topics.title: Relative clauses 1: clauses with who/that/which
topics.summary: Aniqlovchi ergash gap: who / that (odam), that / which (narsa) — ega vazifasida; o'zbekchada aniqlovchi otdan oldin keladi.

topics.title: Relative clauses 2: clauses with and without who/that/which
topics.summary: who / that / which tushib qolishi (to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa): the book I read; predlog oxirida; what va that farqi.

topics.title: Relative clauses 3: whose/whom/where
topics.summary: whose (egalik), whom (rasmiy to'ldiruvchi), where, when, why bilan ergash gaplar.

topics.title: Relative clauses 4: extra information clauses (1)
topics.summary: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi ergash gaplar: vergul bilan, who / which (that emas); aniqlovchi gapdan farqi.

topics.title: Relative clauses 5: extra information clauses (2)
topics.summary: Predlog + whom / which, most of which, all of whom; butun gapga ishora qiluvchi which.

topics.title: -ing and -ed clauses (the woman talking to Tom, the boy injured in the accident)
topics.summary: Qisqartirilgan ergash gaplar: the woman talking to Tom, the boy injured in the accident; there's somebody waiting.

sections.title: Adjectives and adverbs
sections.description: -ing/-ed sifatlar, sifatlar tartibi, sifat va ravish, so/such, enough/too, quite/rather, qiyosiy va orttirma daraja, so'z tartibi.

topics.title: Adjectives ending in -ing and -ed (boring/bored etc.)
topics.summary: -ing (sabab bo'luvchi: boring, interesting) va -ed (his qiluvchi: bored, interested) sifatlari farqi.

topics.title: Adjectives: a nice new house, you look tired
topics.summary: Sifatlar tartibi (fikr, o'lcham, yosh, rang, kelib chiqish ...), look / feel / smell + sifat; the first two days.

topics.title: Adjectives and adverbs 1 (quick/quickly)
topics.summary: Sifat va ravish: `-ly` yasalishi, ravish fe'lni, sifat otni aniqlaydi; ravish + sifat (terribly sorry).

topics.title: Adjectives and adverbs 2 (well, fast, late, hard/hardly)
topics.summary: good / well, fast, late / lately, hard / hardly — ma'no farqlari; hardly ever, hardly any.

topics.title: so and such
topics.summary: so + sifat/ravish, such + (a) sifat + ot; so ... that, such ... that; so long va such a long time.

topics.title: enough and too
topics.summary: enough sifatdan keyin va otdan oldin; too + sifat; too ... / enough ... for somebody to do.

topics.title: quite, pretty, rather and fairly
topics.summary: quite, pretty, rather, fairly — «ancha, biroz» darajalari va ohang farqi; quite = butunlay ma'nosi.

topics.title: Comparative 1 (cheaper, more expensive etc.)
topics.summary: Qiyosiy daraja yasalishi: `-er` va more; imlo, noto'g'ri shakllar (better, worse, further); less.

topics.title: Comparative 2 (much better / any better etc.)
topics.summary: Qiyosiy darajani kuchaytirish: much, a bit, far, any, no better; better and better; the more ..., the more ...

topics.title: Comparative 3 (as … as / than)
topics.summary: as ... as, not as / not so ... as, twice as ... as, the same as; than me / than I am.

topics.title: Superlative (the longest, the most enjoyable etc.)
topics.summary: Orttirma daraja: the `-est` / the most; in va of bilan; one of the best; the best ... I've ever ...

topics.title: Word order 1: verb + object; place and time
topics.summary: Fe'l va to'ldiruvchi orasiga hech narsa qo'yilmaydi; joy va vaqt tartibi (go to work every day).

topics.title: Word order 2: adverbs with the verb
topics.summary: always, also, probably, often, just kabi ravishlarning o'rni; all va both ning gapdagi o'rni.

topics.title: still any more yet already
topics.summary: still va not any more / no longer, yet va still not, already — ma'nosi va gapdagi o'rni.

topics.title: even
topics.summary: even — hatto: kutilmagan narsa; not even, even if, even though, even when; even + qiyosiy daraja.

sections.title: Conjunctions and prepositions
sections.description: although / despite, in case, unless / as long as, as, like / as if, during / for / while, by / until.

topics.title: although though even though in spite of despite
topics.summary: Qarama-qarshilik: although / though / even though + gap, in spite of / despite + ot yoki -ing; gap oxiridagi though.

topics.title: in case
topics.summary: in case — «... bo'lib qolsa deb» (ehtiyot chorasi); if bilan farqi; in case of ...

topics.title: unless as long as provided
topics.summary: unless (agar ... bo'lmasa), as long as / provided (that) — shart bilan; kelasi zamon ma'nosida Present.

topics.title: as (as I walked … / as I was … etc.)
topics.summary: as — «... paytida» va «... chunki»: as I was leaving, as it was late; when va while bilan farqi.

topics.title: like and as
topics.summary: like + ot (kabi, o'xshab) va as + ot (sifatida, vazifasida); as + gap; as usual, such as.

topics.title: like as if
topics.summary: like, as if, as though: look / sound / feel as if ...; as if + o'tgan zamon (xayoliy taqqoslash).

topics.title: during for while
topics.summary: during + ot (qachon), for + muddat (qancha vaqt), while + gap; during va for farqi.

topics.title: by and until by the time …
topics.summary: by (eng kechi ... gacha) va until (... gacha davom etadi); by the time ... — o'tgan va kelasi zamonda.

sections.title: Prepositions
sections.description: Vaqt va joy predloglari, by, ot / sifat / fe'l + predlog birikmalari.

topics.title: at/on/in (time)
topics.summary: Vaqt predloglari: at (soat, at night, at the weekend), on (kun, sana), in (oy, yil, in the morning); in five minutes.

topics.title: on time and in time at the end and in the end
topics.summary: on time (o'z vaqtida) va in time (kech qolmasdan), at the end (oxirida) va in the end (oxir-oqibat).

topics.title: in/at/on (position) 1
topics.summary: Joy predloglari: in (ichida), at (nuqtada), on (sirtda) — in the room, at the bus stop, on the wall.

topics.title: in/at/on (position) 2
topics.summary: Iboralar: in bed, at home, on the train, in a car, on the left, at the top, in the picture.

topics.title: in/at/on (position) 3
topics.summary: Binolar va tadbirlar: at the station / in the station, at a party, at the cinema; at / in + shahar.

topics.title: to, at, in and into
topics.summary: Harakat va joy: go to, arrive at / in, get to, go into, get into a car / on a bus; home predlogsiz.

topics.title: in/on/at (other uses)
topics.summary: in the rain, in a hurry, on holiday, on purpose, on TV, at 50 km an hour, at the age of ... kabi iboralar.

topics.title: by
topics.summary: by ning ma'nolari: by car, by chance, by mistake, by card; majhulda bajaruvchi; by — yonida; by 10%.

topics.title: Noun + preposition (reason for, cause of etc.)
topics.summary: Ot + predlog: a reason for, a cause of, an increase in, a solution to, a relationship with, an advantage of.

topics.title: Adjective + preposition 1
topics.summary: Sifat + predlog: nice of / kind to, angry with / about, excited about, surprised at / by, upset about.

topics.title: Adjective + preposition 2
topics.summary: afraid of, proud of, aware of, good at, married to, similar to, interested in, responsible for, full of.

topics.title: Verb + preposition 1 to and at
topics.summary: talk / listen / apologise to, explain something to somebody; look / stare / smile at; throw at va throw to farqi.

topics.title: Verb + preposition 2 about/for/of/after
topics.summary: ask for, apply for, wait for, search for, look after, look for; ask somebody about ...

topics.title: Verb + preposition 3 about and of
topics.summary: hear about / of / from, think about / of, dream about / of, remind somebody about / of, complain about.

topics.title: Verb + preposition 4 of/for/from/on
topics.summary: accuse of, suspect of, consist of, pay for, blame for, suffer from, protect from, depend on, live on.

topics.title: Verb + preposition 5 in/into/with/to/on
topics.summary: believe in, specialise in, crash into, divide into, provide with, happen to, spend on, concentrate on.

sections.title: Phrasal verbs
sections.description: Frazali fe'llar: in/out, on/off, up/down, away/back — ma'nolari va to'ldiruvchining o'rni.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 1 Introduction
topics.summary: Frazali fe'llar: fe'l + in/out/on/off/up/down — ma'no o'zgarishi; to'ldiruvchi va olmoshning o'rni.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 2 in/out
topics.summary: in / out bilan: check in / out, drop in, move in / out, fill in, join in, leave out, hand in.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 3 out
topics.summary: out bilan: run out of, find out, work out, carry out, point out, turn out, sort out.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 4 on/off (1)
topics.summary: on / off: turn on / off, put on / take off, take off (samolyot), call off, put off, set off.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 5 on/off (2)
topics.summary: on / off: go on / carry on (davom etmoq), get on with, keep on -ing, drop off, see off, show off.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 6 up/down
topics.summary: up / down: put up, pick up, turn up / down, calm down, cut down, break down, let down, write down.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 7 up (1)
topics.summary: up bilan: go up, grow up, bring up, end up, give up, make up, take up, set up, look up.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 8 up (2)
topics.summary: up bilan: tidy up, clean up, wash up, use up, mix up, cheer up, save up, hold up, keep up with.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs 9 away/back
topics.summary: away / back: go away, run away, throw away, give away, put away, call back, pay back, look back.

sections.title: Appendices
sections.description: Ilovalar: fe'l shakllari, barcha zamonlar va kelajak shakllari jadvali, modal fe'llar, qisqa shakllar, imlo va Amerika inglizchasi.

topics.title: Regular and irregular verbs
topics.summary: To'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar: shakllar jadvali, imlo va B1–B2 darajasidagi noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxati.

topics.title: Present and past tenses
topics.summary: Barcha hozirgi va o'tgan zamonlar bitta jadvalda: oddiy, davomli, perfekt va perfekt davomli.

topics.title: The future
topics.summary: Kelajakni ifodalash usullari: Present Continuous, Present Simple, going to, will, will be doing, will have done.

topics.title: Modal verbs (can/could/will/would etc.)
topics.summary: Modal fe'llar jadvali: ma'nolari, hozirgi va o'tgan shakllari (could have, must have, should have).

topics.title: Short forms (I'm / you've / didn't etc.)
topics.summary: Qisqa shakllar: 'm, 's, 're, 've, 'd, 'll, n't; 's va 'd ning ikki ma'nosi; rasmiy matnda to'liq shakl.

topics.title: Spelling
topics.summary: Imlo: `-s`/`-es`, `-ing`, `-ed`, `-er`/`-est`, `-ly` qo'shilganda harflarning o'zgarishi va undoshning ikkilanishi.

topics.title: American English
topics.summary: Britaniya va Amerika inglizchasi farqlari: grammatika (have got / have, Present Perfect), so'zlar va imlo (colour / color).
